negative_findings.description: No standalone Czech 'payments association' equivalent to a national payments council was found. The functional equivalent is Sdružení pro bankovní karty (SBK) plus ČBA's internal payments committees; SBK's web presence appears split across two domains and possibly stale.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched cs terms for a Czech payments association; only SBK and ČBA committee structures surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A scout expecting a single payments-association member directory will not find one; payments actor coverage must be assembled from SBK + ČBA committees + Czech Fintech Association.

negative_findings.description: Fetch of https://www.cbaonline.cz/o-nas/komise-pracovni-skupiny returned only navigation chrome with no committee or chair content.

negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in de/en returned only general chamber descriptions; no committee rosters located.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair each association page with Wayback Machine snapshots and with dated spolkový rejstřík extracts to reconstruct multi-year leadership timelines.

coverage_gaps.description: Associations were assessed as people/pointer sources; their own recruitment pages and members-only job boards (a direct jobs signal) were not investigated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check ČBA, ČEFTAS and AmCham sites for kariéra/careers and member job-board sections, and for HR-committee outputs on labour-market topics.

brief: The Czech association layer is unusually rich as a people-and-pointer source: ČBA (banks, >99% of the sector), ČLFA (leasing/consumer credit), AKAT (capital markets, 100+ members), Česká fintech asociace/ČEFTAS (50-80+ digital-finance firms), SBK (cards/payments) and ČKMA (crypto) all publish member directories and elected governing bodies staffed by named serving executives, and SP ČR's sectoral-association registry lets you enumerate these bodies exhaustively rather than guessing. Bilateral chambers add an English-language layer — AmCham CZ exposes a Finance Committee, a board of country CEOs and a corporate directory — though ČNOPK and the British Chamber could not be confirmed to publish finance-committee rosters in this pass. The highest-value analytical move is diffing these rosters over time and anchoring every person-level fact in the spolkový rejstřík, which timestamps statutory-body changes independently of what the associations choose to publish. Main friction is technical rather than legal: content is public and collectible, but ČBA's committee pages did not yield content to a static fetch and several sites need headless rendering or on-site link discovery.
